rules.ball: tiled full-resolution detection plus the full-frame one, minus the penalty and centre spots; conf >= 0.5 stands alone, weaker only within 35 m/s of the nearest confident one (1 s) or at conf >= 0.4 with none near
rules.dead_ball: null once the ball is past a line, and from a goal's reviewed strike (a disallowed goal: its tagged second) to the end of the shot
rules.goal_line: positions on or behind the goal line are valued 0.5 m out (the model has no shots there)
rules.holder: tracked player nearest the ball within 2.5 m, else 'ball loose'
rules.in_flight: no holder while the ball's ground speed exceeds 12 m/s over ~0.2 s (a pass or a ball in the air, whose ground position a single camera cannot place), or where it cannot be measured (fewer than two ball detections within 0.12 s)
rules.keepers: by position, one per goal, plus track B's hand corrections (moments/overrides.json, same camera shot, which also remove referees): opponents for control, never pass options
rules.onside: offside_risk = within 0.5 m of the line (second-last defender, ball or halfway); never best
rules.own_half: no xG while the holder or the receiver is in his own half (the model has no shots there)
rules.possession: the holder's team must hold for 3 samples (0.3 s) before possession switches; a holder of the other team before then is 'possession unsettled'
rules.possession_carrier: the same player at the ball before and after a gap of <= 1.5 s with the ball unseen and no other player within 1.5 m of him keeps it through the gap (carrier_source 'possession'); never across a ball seen elsewhere
rules.trusted: false where the camera fit is not trusted at the frame, or no ball and no possession carrier
